title: Ocean River RV Resort

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: Woodland Tent sites offer guests an immersive natural experience amidst mature trees. Each site includes a fire ring, picnic table, and access to a star-lit sky. The recently renovated restrooms provide spacious, hot showers in a well-maintained setting. Guests can enjoy warm days at the pool, rent a kayak or canoe to explore the river, or fish for striped bass. The sites are generously sized, offering ample space for comfort and relaxation. Choose from a generously sized forested tent site in the middle of nature, or a grassy electric-water site with trees on one or more sides and a partial river view. services.name: Mini Yurt
services.desc: The ultimate in tenting comfort! Enjoy a luxury camping experience from the comfort of a cozy 16' yurt set among towering trees. The large off ground deck is a clean and comfortable place to relax. At night watch for shooting stars, or bask in the glow of a crackling campfire. Your glam-camping Yurt is outfitted with a queen bed, linens, cozy blanket, night stands, lanterns, fan/light and cushions. We include 2 outdoor chairs for relaxing comfort on the deck, along with a picnic table and fire pit. Enjoy a hot shower in the newly renovated bathhouse, just 250' from your glamping site. services.desc: Please Note: The RV is currently under renovation and unavailable for booking until further notice. Enjoy this spacious 2-bedroom RV rental which features a master queen bedroom, and a bunk bedroom. The large living area contains a full service kitchen, dinette, and comfortable seating area to read your favorite book. A three piece bath rounds out this vacation home. Free wifi available at the main building. Optional premium wifi at your site is available for $5/night. Linens and blankets are provided in the master bedroom.
